rights.scope: Source links and original research summaries only; not a screenshot license or cross-project reuse grant.

limits: Entries are discovery candidates, not verified references, ready packs or universal design answers.
Historical observations retain their dates; no source frame was freshly inspected during catalog preparation.
The 24-product study does not retain per-product frame closure. Never divide its 48-screen total into invented per-product evidence.
Frame links preserve historical identifiers but are not local capture bytes or content hashes. A source URL can change.
Family/component tags are research indexing hypotheses, not evidence-backed product-fit ratings or extracted component recipes.
Popularity was not revalidated; do not rank candidates by guessed counts or turn unknown into zero.
No source interaction, responsive transition, font, exact color, CSS value or accessibility behavior is certified by this catalog.
No private project captures, login data, selection, approval or source authority are imported.
Source-brand names and these notes are for research/Owner use, never a downstream creator prompt.
Public page text may be cached and may omit gated or client-rendered frames. Login in that text says nothing about the user's browser session.
